messages.subject: explanation of note
parts:
Dear all,

Most probably this is a very stupid question, but what does the following mean:

Note: model has only an intercept; equivalent type-III tests substituted.

Thanks!
Ellen

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] explanation of note
parts:
This is a warning generated by the Anova function from the car
package, which ezANOVA uses. The warning occurs when you do a
completely within-Ss design and can be ignored.
